item.text: The old path resolves to one retained file identity. I’m now querying by that identity—the required step that brings tombstones/deletion states into the result instead of silently omitting them.

statements.sql: SELECT id, path, directory_id, name, CAST(data AS TEXT) AS content, lixcol_depth, lixcol_observed_commit_id, lixcol_commit_created_at FROM lix_file_history WHERE lixcol_start_commit_id = lix_active_branch_commit_id() AND id = $1 ORDER BY lixcol_depth ASC
